data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: planning processes (brainstorm + impl-plan) mint new config keys instead of reusing existing ones — no 'config-surface impact' gate exists in brainstorm/preplanning/implementation-plan or approach-decision-maker. Classification: COMPLEX — multi-skill LLM-behavioral change spanning 3+ planning prompts and the approach-decision-maker agent. The dso.workflow consolidation epic (mentioned in ticket as 'about to be brainstormed') is the proper home; check for that successor before adding standalone gates that may duplicate. Per rule:bug-close-with-code, leaving OPEN; recommend dedicated epic.
